subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The beauty of cherry blossoms is __ephemeral__, as the delicate pink petals bloom for only a short period.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ephemeral"** means something that lasts for a very short period. (अल्पकालिक)

 
 
• **Example: **The joy of winning the game was** ephemeral,** as the team soon faced another challenge.
 
 
 
• **"Permanent"** refers to something that lasts for a very long time or forever; it is the opposite of ephemeral. (स्थायी)
 
 
• **Example: **They decided to make a **permanent** move to the countryside.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'ephemeral'** is **'permanent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Uniform** (समरूप): Consistent; unvarying.

 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers wore a **uniform** dress code.
 
 
 
• **Unwavering** (अटल): Steady or resolute; not wavering.
 
 
• **Example:** She showed** unwavering** support for her friend.
 
 
 
• **Transient** (क्षणिक): Lasting for only a short time; impermanent.
 
 
• **Example:** The **transient** nature of the job made it less appealing.
